# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The definition of an antiSkyrmion in this paper involves changing the sign of only one pion field, which differs from the method in refs. [3, 12, 7] where all three pion signs are changed, allowing for a more direct comparison with monopoles.
- A Skyrmion and an antiSkyrmion are joined continuously where the profile function is zero at a radius s/2 from the center of each, and the fields are set to the vacuum outside these cores.
- Sophisticated initial conditions were utilized based on the rational map ansatz [11] with an axially symmetric charge n map, in addition to the simple ansatz (3.7).
